<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
f=current_frame; rows=f.ascii.split('\n')
def pat(r0,r1,c0,c1,cols):
    return frozenset((r-r0,cc-c0) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for cc in range(c0,c1+1) if rows[r][cc] in cols)
def rot(p): return frozenset((c, -r) for r,c in p)
def norm(p):
    mr=min(r for r,c in p); mc=min(c for r,c in p)
    return frozenset((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in p)
def rots(p):
    out=set()
    for _ in range(4):
        out.add(norm(p)); p=rot(p)
    return out
BL=pat(21,32,12,23,'BW'); BR=pat(27,32,45,56,'BW')
Yt=pat(3,14,33,44,'YW'); Yb=pat(42,53,33,44,'YW'); YLt=pat(9,14,9,20,'YW'); Yl=pat(42,47,9,20,'YW')
print("sizes",len(BL),len(BR),len(Yt),len(Yb),len(YLt),len(Yl))
for a,an in [(BL,'BL'),(BR,'BR')]:
    ra=rots(a)
    for b,bn in [(Yt,'Yt'),(Yb,'Yb'),(YLt,'YLt'),(Yl,'Yl')]:
        if len(a)==len(b) and any(x in ra for x in [norm(b)]):
            print("MATCH",an,bn)
        elif len(a)==len(b):
            # report min symmetric difference
            best=min(len(x^norm(b)) for x in ra)
            print("close?",an,bn,"symdiff",best)
# probe LEFT
def bbs(col):
    return [(n['pixels'],min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']==col and n['pixels']>20]
print("B before:",bbs('B'))
action(['LEFT'])
print("B after:",bbs('B'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

f=current_frame; rows=f.ascii.split('\n')
def pat(r0,r1,c0,c1,cols):
    return frozenset((r-r0,cc-c0) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for cc in range(c0,c1+1) if rows[r][cc] in cols)
def rot(p): return frozenset((c, -r) for r,c in p)
def norm(p):
    mr=min(r for r,c in p); mc=min(c for r,c in p)
    return frozenset((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in p)
def rots(p):
    out=set()
    for _ in range(4):
        out.add(norm(p)); p=rot(p)
    return out
